scenarios.recovery: leave flows Draft, preserve the plan/journal, repair approved bindings, rerun preflight
scenarios.limitation: No connection repair or activation claim

scenarios.detection: preflight/manual prerequisite or bounded request observation
scenarios.recovery: stop activation and escalate for approved capacity/licensing review
scenarios.limitation: Sequential synthetic observation; no licensing entitlement or service-protection limit claimed

scenarios.detection: identity, role, or queue-grant readback fails
scenarios.recovery: stop mutations and use an approved administrator to restore ownership, then rerun identity/preflight
scenarios.limitation: Current tenant has no assigned WQ Worker/Reader validation identities; no role mutation was attempted

scenarios.recovery: reject before mutation and create a fresh reviewed binding

scenarios.detection: durable deployment journal is Failed, LaunchFailed, or Running after worker termination
scenarios.recovery: preserve journal/target state, reconcile only recorded partial deployment, then use a new reviewed plan
scenarios.limitation: Unmanaged development import; clean managed import and upgrade remain open

scenarios.recovery: allow installed autonomous flows to continue and inspect durable evidence later

scenarios.detection: unknown status, lease expiry, or discarded external response
scenarios.recovery: reconcile stable identity, verify effects, and retry only with current expected version
scenarios.limitation: Synthetic target and connector-response-loss injection remain separate evidence

scenarios.detection: bounded health, maintenance receipt, stale lease, or review-required item
scenarios.recovery: run bounded maintenance and inspect active/review-held work before advancing
scenarios.limitation: Event-parent activation and broad load remain open

scenarios.detection: no trusted read or mutation path to the same environment
scenarios.recovery: use separately operated monitoring/escalation and wait for service recovery
scenarios.limitation: Core cannot self-notify during its own outage; external monitoring remains a human/operations prerequisite
